recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中兩個偏心圓核的漿細胞共用一片強嗜鹼性、邊緣呈纖維狀毛邊的細胞質，細胞質內隱約有粉紫色細絲狀結構；本圖解析度不足，題目所稱的類 Auer 棒狀包涵體無法清楚辨認。
features: Two plasma cells (or a binucleate plasma cell) with round eccentric nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin
Abundant, intensely basophilic cytoplasm with a fibrillary, frayed and streaming border
Faint pink-purple wisps within the cytoplasm; discrete Auer rod-like needles not clearly resolved
Sparse background with scattered red cells showing drying artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two closely apposed plasma cells, possibly a binucleate form, with round eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin and abundant intensely basophilic cytoplasm with a fibrillary, frayed border. Faint pink-purple filamentous material is present within the cytoplasm, but discrete rod-shaped azurophilic inclusions are not clearly resolved at this resolution. The red cells in the background show drying artifact. The plasma cells are compatible with the reported myeloma, but the Auer rod-like inclusions in the title are only partially demonstrated in this field.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are polytypic and lack crystalline inclusions or multinucleation; clonality by kappa/lambda staining or flow cytometry is required.
Flame cells show fuchsinophilic red-pink cytoplasm with frayed edges rather than deep blue cytoplasm with crystalline rods.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: Auer rods are in blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and MPO positivity, not in mature plasma cells with clumped chromatin.
Osteoblasts also have eccentric nuclei and blue cytoplasm but are larger, comet-shaped, occur in clusters and have a hof separated from the nucleus.
